# Let users undo an accidental home status change

## What & Why
The home page can now move an opportunity to Applied with one click, but an accidental click requires editing the opportunity from the applications page to recover. A short-lived undo action would make this shortcut safer.

## Done looks like
- After Mark applied, the home page offers an accessible undo action for the changed opportunity.
- Undo restores the previous status and keeps the complete opportunity details intact.
- The recovery behavior persists correctly through the existing local browser storage flow.
